+
     return int(unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(score)])

generation_parents.algorithm: The heuristic scores each feasible customer by a weighted mix of distance from the current node and a savings-style estimate of route efficiency, defined as current-to-customer distance plus customer-to-depot distance minus the current-to-depot distance scaled by capacity pressure, selecting the highest-scoring node to favor customers that extend the route efficiently.
